_comment: Provider adapters for the floor-plan benchmark. Every paid adapter is disabled and stays disabled in this file. An approved run enables a provider for one invocation only, and needs ALL of: an approved run manifest (runs/approved-run.json), --paid, --enable <id>, FLH_FPA_PAID_RUN equal to the manifest runId, and the provider key in the environment. imageTokenBound, thinkingAllowanceTokens and modelMaxOutputTokens feed the budget bound in budget.mjs. Values marked unverified must be confirmed before a run.

providers._bounds: Documented: max_tokens is the hard ceiling on total output including thinking; high-resolution image cap 4,784 tokens.
Documented: max_tokens is the hard ceiling on total output including thinking; high-resolution image cap 4,784 tokens.

UNVERIFIED: model code (search snippets show gemini-3-flash-preview), whether thoughts count toward maxOutputTokens (8,192 extra allowed), model maximum output (65,536 assumed for the overshoot reserve), image token count (4,784 used pessimistically; docs reportedly say 1,120 at HIGH).
